nativeSampling.capabilityPolicy: Only actual structured error.code===-32601 for the exact requested CDP command is UNAVAILABLE. Playwright may not expose code; message-only notfound then STOP. protocol.cleanup: Separate total5s after samplewall/lease expiry. If sampler may be active and stop not yet attempted, attempt one stop under remaining cleanup budget; then close owned browser/server/Vite. Stop may consume entire cleanup deadline; deadline triggers ownedkill, records cleanup unconfirmed. Failed stop is never retried; ownedkill mandatory. Uncertain pendingstart can settle late, so any failed run kills ownedbrowser even after stop ACK. stopAttempted is set only at actual send dispatch, not an earlier budget check. If wall expires before dispatch, the distinct cleanup remains eligible. Urgent2GiB RSS guard kills ownedbrowser immediately for protection and recordsurgentOwnedKill; other errors attempt stop before ownedkill.
